description: This file defines the VideoDecoderCache class, which manages a cache of video decoder information for Android media codecs. It includes methods for refreshing the cache and retrieving decoders capable of handling specific MIME types, with cache expiration logic.

classes.name: VideoDecoderCache
classes.description: A thread-safe cache manager for storing and retrieving video decoder capabilities on Android devices.

classes.name: VideoDecoderCache.CachedDecoder
classes.description: A data class representing cached information about a specific video decoder, including its capabilities and supported ranges.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the cache has expired based on TTL override or default TTL.

methods.name: refreshDecoders
methods.description: Refreshes the cache by querying available media codecs and storing decoders that support video.

methods.name: getCachedDecoders
methods.description: Returns a list of cached decoders capable of decoding a specified MIME type, refreshing cache if expired.
